name: iQuHACK 2026
description: iQuHACK (interdisciplinary Quantum HACKathon) is MIT's annual quantum computing hackathon organized by the interdisciplinary Quantum Information Science and Engineering (iQuISE) program. The 7th edition brought together over 400 students in person at MIT plus online participants. Teams work on quantum computing challenges using various platforms and frameworks.
eligibility: Open to students worldwide (in-person at MIT or online)

MIT's 7th annual quantum hackathon, iQuHACK, nurtures a new generation of quantum enthusiasts | The Tech

news.title: iQuHACK 2026 draws record 1,400+ participants across 76 countries
news.excerpt: 1,400+ participants attended iQuHACK 2026, with more than 400 students from U.S. universities participating in person and 1,000 students from 76 countries joining virtually

news.title: Remote Applications Open for iQuHACK 2026
news.excerpt: iQuHACK 2026 remote applications are still open to the public. In-person applications are now closed. The hackathon runs January 30 to February 1, 2026.
